classes.name: AesGcmDecryptingStream
classes.description: A class implementing an AES GCM decryption stream for secure data processing, supporting PHP versions below and above 7.1.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decrypting stream with ciphertext, key, IV, authentication tag, additional data, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method string based on key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES GCM algorithm name string.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Retrieves the current initialization vector used for decryption.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a decrypted stream object, handling different PHP versions and performing decryption accordingly.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable (always false in this implementation).
